task: RC206 movement-matched Slayer four-view swordless/armless body candidate

references.use: Primary identity, body proportions, walk-ready stance, low carried-weapon body posture, and cape silhouette reference.
Secondary identity and armor detail reference; the extra-wide action stance was explicitly excluded.

candidate_file.layout: 2x2 square board; four 627x627 cells at origins (0,0), (627,0), (0,627), (627,627).
candidate_file.visual_inspection: Actual-viewed. The upper-left is front, upper-right back, lower-left is front three-quarter but faces screen-left rather than the requested screen-right, and lower-right is rear three-quarter turned toward screen-right. All four are compact walk-ready bodies with close/staggered feet rather than a broad fighting stance. They retain black hair, black/gunmetal and red armor, and red-black cape. All arms and weapons are omitted, with closed shoulder plates and no obvious circular socket or hole. The lower-left cell can be mirrored in the root if desired; no pixel edit was made.

alpha_qa.notes: No visible silhouette alpha>=6 touches a cell edge. Low-alpha (byte 1-5) fringes do touch some outer cell edges and bottom edges, including both lower cells; the visible silhouettes remain inside with 11-38px margins there. Alpha byte>=6 active silhouettes have 64px or more between adjacent columns in the lower row and 112px in the upper row.

landmarks.coordinate_system: Local coordinates are within a 627x627 cell; global coordinates are on the 1254x1254 board. Head tops are alpha>=6 bounds; head centers are visual estimates from the head region. Sole centers and shoulder attachment points are manual visual estimates, not semantic detections; shoulder estimates are about +/-20px.
landmarks.alignment: Top-row sole baselines are y=606; lower-row sole baselines are y=588, so moving both lower cells down about 19px aligns soles. After that move, lower-row head tops differ from upper-row tops by about 4px. Visible body heights are similar (approximately 573-578px). Horizontal foot/head pivots vary by view and should be stored per cell.

limitations: The generated lower-left front-three-quarter faces screen-left; a horizontal mirror can orient it toward screen-right if the root accepts that use.
The generated low-alpha fringe touches some cell borders despite the main alpha>=6 silhouettes having adequate margins.
No second image generation or source-image modification was performed.
